# Review capture evidence

These six PNG captures were produced before the final D1 content-integrity patch (commit `83fadc255611e14cf764d85fa78cffa6a008acbb` and later).

They remain useful for overall layout reference, but they are **not current visual evidence** for that commit or any later commit. Fresh visual captures are required during D2 or when a browser environment that can load the local site becomes available.

The binary images are intentionally retained and have not been deleted or represented as freshly regenerated.
